attributes.board_name: Washington State Veterinary Board of Governors (Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses by approved providers (WAC 246-933-460): AAVSB RACE-approved courses, AVMA, AVMA-accredited colleges and recognized specialty organizations, government agencies, veterinary medical associations, AAVLD, USAHA, RAIVE and others; live remote courses with real-time Q&A unlimited
rules.alternatives: Becoming board-certified by an AVMA-recognized specialty organization during the reporting period, or full enrollment in an approved residency (max two periods), meets the requirement.
rules.audit_note: Board may audit up to 25% of veterinarians after renewal, and for cause.

topics.who: Board-listed course; by end of first full reporting period after initial licensure
One-time Board-listed Washington law training before the first license renewal

rules.notes: 30 h every two years, due on the renewal date: at least 20 h scientific/clinical; max 10 h practice management, 10 h teaching, 10 h preprogrammed (non-interactive) material with an assessment.
